patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Same category, different company size. Choose commercetools only if your buying job matches “Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sale” rather than Square Online's shape. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than commercetools's shape. Workflow advantage: commercetools leans wholesale-b2b; Square Online leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: commercetools is Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sales. Shopify keeps the SaaS award.; Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers.
- Company-size focus: commercetools (mid-market, enterprise) vs Square Online (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: commercetools-leaning wholesale-b2b vs Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: commercetools — No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify.

Limitations — commercetools: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Requires front-end / MACH assembly — not a weekend theme launch; Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume.

Poor-fit cases: commercetools is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet · Square Online is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify · Avoid commercetools if you actually need Square Online's motion (Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
